summary: DEX aggregator SwapNet was exploited, resulting in the loss of more than $16M in user funds; Matcha Meta warned its users may also be affected due to exposure via SwapNet integrations.
user_mistake: attacker exploited SwapNet smart contract/approval logic, abusing existing token approvals to drain user funds
prevention: check affected wallets, immediately revoke all open token approvals (especially non–one-time approvals), avoid interacting with SwapNet-related contracts, and monitor wallets for unauthorized activity
classification_warning: Revoke.cash and Matcha Meta issued alerts urging users to verify exposure and revoke approvals
